name: cc-enslaver
description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.23 adds rule 12 (repo-wide sync) and a hard TL;DR length contract. rule 12 upgrades 'done' from 'the target file is correct' to 'every repo-wide reference moved with it': read_guard records every accepted Edit/Write into a per-session edited-files set; projects register known co-update invariants in .claude/cc-enslaver/sync-gate.toml ([[groups]] with when/require globs); the new Stop layer (i) blocks an edit-turn done-claim whose when-group matched with no require-side edit and no explicit sync-acknowledgement marker (同步核对 / sync-check) in the reply — per-project opt-in, failing-open, marker escape by design so 'checked, no change needed' stays a legitimate explicit outcome. The active half is the new repo-refresh skill: an on-demand systematic sweep of the whole repository (docs and code) for stale, outdated, redundant, wrong, and drifted content, every finding carrying file:line evidence. The v0.20 tldr closing gains a length cap enforced at Stop layer (h): each tldr item is one sentence — cause, action, outcome — within 160 characters; several things to report → one short line each; an overlong item blocks with a dedicated recovery. v0.23 also fixes two pre-existing HIGH defects surfaced by a live-state E2E audit: production hook payloads carry no turn_count, so the edit-gated Stop layers (e)/(f)/(g) had never fired outside the test suite — the edit signal is now an edited_since_last_stop flag plus a synthesized per-session stop counter that also restores the one-shot grace window; and session state suffered lost-update races under parallel hook processes (measured 2-3 of 10 recorded paths lost) — every mutation now holds a cross-process file lock and saves atomically. Prior: v0.22 added write-time content detectors rules 10 (no non-essential hardcoding: secret-named literals, PEM private-key headers, AWS access keys, credentials-in-URL) and 11 (no non-essential path dependency: machine-specific user-home absolute paths), both PreToolUse-only with a why-comment escape hatch and prose-doc/lockfile exemptions; v0.22.1 sharpened rule 06 with Check 2b (aggregate-equal is not unchanged; a green gate proves nothing about what it does not check) and rule 09 with a bulk-mechanical-edit discipline plus closed-set guards; v0.22.2 added the version-drift gate pinning every manifest version pointer, the README badge, and the newest CHANGELOG heading to plugin.json. English remains the i18n skeleton and source of truth (rules/ + prompts/ at the root, default injection); Chinese is a first-class translation (rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/, via CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), with drift CI-blocked by i18n_check.py + test_i18n_sync.py.
